cohort: Very preterm (24-31 weeks' gestational age) very-low-birth-weight (≤1500 g) infants born in Israel between 1995-2015
finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of NEC only in multiple pregnancies, while lower gestational age, SGA, and PDA were associated with higher NEC risk in both singletons and multiples.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of NEC in multiple pregnancies.
